finding: Slovak firms' bank credit access gap more than doubled the euro area rate
bullets: A net 10.21% of Slovak firms (n=104) seeking bank loans were either discouraged from applying or turned down in wave 40, more than double the EA’s 4.67% (n=3,622).
chart_subtitle: 10.21% of Slovak firms were discouraged or rejected for bank loans.
grounding_dropped: Slovak applicants faced a rejection rate of 11.20% (n=104) versus 2.55% in the EA (n=3,622), making outright refusals the dominant driver of Slovakia’s elevated financing gap.
Slovakia’s bank loan application rate rose from 19.01% (wave 39, n=131) to 34.65% (wave 40, n=104), with discouragement also rising from 1.81% to 6.33% over the same period.
